# Bitdepth

> Independent nightly grades for AI inference endpoints. Every endpoint serving the same open-weight model is probed each night with the same prompt set, scored against a published reference, and shown beside its price.

Contact: hello@bitdepth.dev

## Pages

- [Home](https://bitdepth.dev/): what a grade is, what it answers, and how to request a model.
- [About](https://bitdepth.dev/about): what Bitdepth does in plain words, how a request reaches a provider, why it is called Bitdepth, a glossary and common questions.
- [Method](https://bitdepth.dev/method): the unit, the nightly procedure, the reference rule, the noise floor, rubric v0 and the publication policy.
- [Market](https://bitdepth.dev/market): reserving inference capacity at a fixed price with the grade checked nightly.
